LESSON: DRAWING FROM MAKING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.2: Drawing from MAKING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Drawing from MAKING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate tools to draw simple pictures
2. draw symbolic representation of things found in the classroom from memory
3. appreciate each other’s, drawing pairs and groups as they handle and sharpen pencils. available on various computing Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use appropriate tools to draw simple pictures
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate tools to draw simple pictures. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. draw symbolic representation of things found in the classroom from memory
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to draw symbolic representation of things found in the classroom from memory. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate each other’s, drawing pairs and groups as they handle and sharpen pencils. available on various computing Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate each other’s, drawing pairs and groups as they handle and sharpen pencils. available on various computing Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Drawing from MAKING.
2. Explain Drawing from MAKING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Drawing from MAKING.
4. Show that you can: use appropriate tools to draw simple pictures
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Drawing from MAKING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Drawing from MAKING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate tools to draw simple pictures
2. draw symbolic representation of things found in the classroom from memory
3. appreciate each other’s, drawing pairs and groups as they handle and sharpen pencils. available on various computing Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
